notes:
Context and ask:
- Mid-market SaaS (B2B CX tools) evaluating Redwood after Hosted API trial. Primary contact: CTO Jeremy Cole; product lead Sara Nguyen. Trial used hosted endpoints for chat-based agent and vector search (Faiss on their side + Redwood embeddings).

Hosted API trial summary (observed):
- Duration: 2 weeks, ~60k API requests total.
- Traffic shape: weekday peaks 11:00-14:00 PT, evening troughs.
- Observed QPS: peak sustained ~22 qps during 5-min windows, burst to ~40 qps for <1 min.
- Average concurrency seen (client side): 6-12 concurrent user sessions; backend aggregation caused ~30 concurrent requests at peak.
notes_2:
Token mix & workload details:
- Chat (user-facing agent): ~55% of requests. Typical prompt+context tokens: 80-350 (average 220). Long context sessions (~5% of chats) reach 1k-1.5k tokens.
- Embeddings (doc-search indexing): ~30% of requests but batched; average 512 tokens per doc embedding; daily throughput ~50k docs during catch-up.
- Reranking (candidate scoring): ~10% of requests, high QPS sensitivity, short token sizes (30-80 tokens) but need low-latency tail.
- Misc (analytics, offline evals): ~5% - run in off-peak windows.
- Estimated average tokens/request across all workloads: ~350 tokens.

POC technical feedback (from SE notes):
- Latency targets: p50 <80ms for short prompts, p95 <450ms for long-context chat.
- Throughput target for Dedicated: support sustained 30 qps with headroom to 100 qps bursts using autoscaling/burst capacity.
- Desired concurrency headroom: plan for 40-60 concurrent sessions (internal estimate).
- Cache opportunity: many requests share prefixes for support dialogs -> expect 15-25% token savings with prefix/KV caching.

Business / procurement drivers:
- Price sensitive: ROI model requires < $150k annual inference cost for core chat + embeddings workloads at projected scale (Est. ARR $250k+ with 3-year expansion plan).
- Must have SOC2/SSO/KMS and contract DPA. Data residency: default NA, EU support expected in phase 2.
- Prefer Dedicated for predictable cost and isolation; are open to Redwood Dedicated or Private if pricing and timelines align.

Requested from Redwood sales/engineering:
- Draft Dedicated capacity sizing: number of GPU nodes (or equivalent slots), recommended instance types, suggested burst capacity plan, autoscale policy examples.
- Traffic forecast worksheet: convert their hosted trial telemetry into a 12-month projection (QPS profile, concurrency, token mix, monthly token totals).
- Pricing estimate: committed reserved capacity tiers vs burstable; example fees for 6/12/24 month commitments.

Quotes / direct paraphrases from calls:
- "We like the observability — token-level cost numbers were eye opening." — Sara Nguyen, Product Lead.
- "Need to know if we can hit p95 SLAs for long chats before we commit to Dedicated." — Jeremy Cole, CTO.
